data.name: SymbolInvalid
data.value: An AMQP symbol must be non-null seven-bit ASCII text.

data.name: FrameSizeInvalid
data.value: The AMQP maximum frame size must be at least 512 bytes.

data.name: CarrierNotReliableStream
data.value: AMQP requires a carrier that delivers a reliable, ordered byte stream.

data.name: CarrierStreamNotAcquired
data.value: The AMQP stream of the multiplexed carrier has not been acquired.

data.name: CarrierStreamNotBidirectional
data.value: The first stream the peer opened on the multiplexed carrier is not bidirectional, so it cannot carry an AMQP connection.

data.name: ProtocolHeaderNotNegotiated
data.value: AMQP protocol header negotiation must be performed before exchanging frames.

data.name: ProtocolHeaderIncomplete
data.value: The carrier stream ended before the AMQP protocol header was fully received.

data.name: FrameIncomplete
data.value: The carrier stream ended with an incomplete AMQP frame.

data.name: HandshakeTimedOut
data.value: The AMQP connection was not established within the handshake timeout of {0}.
